plan.project_name: CLI Todo App with Local Storage
plan.summary: A command line interface todo app with local storage for managing tasks and tracking progress.

phases.name: Setup
steps: Create an express server to handle API requests
Initialize and create a local storage file for the app
Create the API key for local storage

phases.name: User Authentication
steps: Implement authentication using Node.js authentication functions
Store the user token in local storage

phases.name: Todo Store
steps: Implement a todo list and database for storing tasks
Use an async API call to fetch or create tasks in the database

manual_checklist: Use the mimetype-api library to specify the appropriate mimetype for each file type

idea: a CLI todo app with local storage

plan.summary: A CLI tool for managing to-do lists, allowing users to add, remove, and mark tasks as done.

phases.name: Front-end Development
steps: Create a CLI application using Click.
Integrate SQLite3 into the project for local storage.
Design user interface elements such as adding, deleting, and marking tasks.

phases.name: Back-end Development
steps: Develop the backend server using Flask or equivalent.
Handle user authentication to secure the data.
Integrate the front-end CLI into the backend for real-time updates.
Implement features like search and filter capabilities for easier task management.

manual_checklist: Create a README file, install dependencies, and set up a development environment.
